GFM 扩展：表格（支持列对齐，太宽时在自己的框里横向滚动）、任务列表、删除线和: GFM extensions: tables (with column alignment; wide ones scroll inside their own box), task lists, strikethrough and bare links turned into links.
Markdown 源码；为空时什么也不渲染: Markdown source; renders nothing when empty
className 调整字号和行高，适合评论、消息这类小块内容。: className adjusts the font size and line height, for small pieces such as comments and messages.
代码块上方显示语言和复制按钮，没写语言时显示 text；行内代码用等宽字体。: A code block shows its language and a copy button above it (text when none is given); inline code is monospaced.
外层容器的 class，可以调整字号和行高: Class of the outer container; can adjust the font size and line height
左边编辑源码，右边实时预览；用 useDeferredValue 让长文档输入时: Edit the source on the left with a live preview on the right; useDeferredValue keeps typing smooth in long documents.
把 Markdown 渲染成带项目排版的内容：标题、列表、引用、表格、任务列表、: Renders Markdown with the project's typography: headings, lists, quotes, tables, task lists, strikethrough, links (opened in a new tab) and code blocks with a copy button, in light and dark themes. HTML tags in the source are shown as text and never run, so user input is safe to render. Code blocks aren't syntax-highlighted, and there is no editor: pair it with a text area for editing.
